name: ColorPicker
whenToUse: Any color, including custom: brand and theme colors, chart series, white-label setup.
`ColorField` in forms — a text field with a swatch that opens the picker.

anatomy.description: Palette, From photo, Custom — choose with `views`.

do.caption: In a form: a field that shows and accepts the hex, the picker on demand.

dont.caption: Two presets for a brand color — the customer’s own color isn’t there.
dont.example:
<SwatchPicker
  aria-label="Brand color"
  shape="square"
  options={[{ value: 'a', label: 'Indigo', color: '#4f46e5' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Teal', color: '#0d9488' }]}
  defaultValue="a"
/>

a11y: The area and each slider are keyboard-operable (arrows, Home/End) and announce the value.
Always keep the text input — it’s the precise, accessible way to set a color.
Check the chosen color’s contrast where it’s used; the picker doesn’t know the context.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Adds the alpha slider and a % field; the value becomes #rrggbbaa when not opaque.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a "No color" swatch to the palette; picking it sets the value to ''.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Shows the EyeDropper button where the browser supports it.

props.name: formats
props.description: Formats offered in the input row.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires continuously while dragging and on every input commit.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Fires when a drag ends, a key is released or an input commits — for saving/undo history.

props.name: photo
props.description: Initial image for the From photo view (the user can upload another).

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors for the Palette view.

props.name: value
props.description: Hex color (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa). An empty string means "no color" (see `clearable`).

props.name: viewLabels
props.description: Tab names.

props.name: views
props.description:
Which sources to offer. More than one renders tabs (Palette / From photo / Custom).
Defaults to ['palette', 'custom'] when `swatches` are passed, otherwise ['custom'].
